company.shortDescription: DIGS provides coworking spaces, offices, meeting rooms, and event venues with community support.
company.description: DIGS is Trondheim’s first official coworking space -- an open office and innovation platform with members working to unite entrepreneurs, ‘makers’ and ‘doers’ from varied disciplines and sectors. DIGS provides an office environment that stimulates the culture of collaboration, sustainability and mutual innovation through sharing knowledge and learning. They aim to spark innovation, strengthen networks and stimulate local community.
